page: OVHcloud c3-64 is a compute-optimized cloud instance powered by a dedicated 32-core AMD EPYC processor running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. Configured with a 1:1 physical-to-virtual core allocation without simultaneous multithreading, each of the 32 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core. The instance provides 64 GB of system RAM, maintaining a 2 GB per core ratio, backed by 32 MB of L3 cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache per core, and hardware-assisted virtualization via KVM and AMD SVM. The instance does not feature a dedicated GPU.

Local storage is provided via an integrated 400 GB NVMe SSD, delivering rapid local read and write operations. The networking interface supports a baseline throughput of 4 Gbps, though no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance by default. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AES, SHA_NI, BMI2, and FMA, though AVX-512 and AMX extensions are absent.

Performance benchmarks show high multi-threaded throughput and memory capabilities. Multi-core compute benchmarks such as stress-ng (98,610.77) and Geekbench multi-core (16,372.0) place the instance within the top 25 percent tier, driven by full core dedication. PassMark CPU reached 63,662.12, complemented by a top 10 percent PassMark memory score of 2,995.4 and uncached read memory bandwidth exceeding 227 GB/s. In application-specific workloads, the server achieved 77.38 million Redis SET operations per second and demonstrated strong clang compilation throughput at 43,930.0 points.

The primary tradeoff of the c3-64 resides in its 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio and moderate single-core benchmark metrics, placing Geekbench single-core (1,896.0) in the middle 50 percent bracket. Consequently, the instance delivers high compute density and cost efficiency for parallelized processing tasks, but is less optimal for single-threaded or memory-intensive in-memory data sets. Best-fit deployments include distributed CI/CD build farms, parallel batch processing, multi-threaded video or image rendering, Redis caching layers, and database workloads requiring dedicated execution units and direct NVMe access.
description: OVHcloud c3-64 is a compute-optimized instance equipped with 32 dedicated physical AMD EPYC cores operating at 2.3 GHz, 64 GB of system memory, and a bundled 400 GB NVMe SSD. Designed with a 1:1 thread-to-core mapping, it allocates 2 GB of memory per vCPU and operates on a KVM hypervisor with 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, omitting dedicated GPUs. In benchmarking evaluations, the c3-64 demonstrates robust parallel processing and memory transfer capabilities, ranking in the top 25 percent for multi-core stress-ng tests, Clang compilation, and database operations, alongside a top 10 percent PassMark memory tier ranking. While single-thread execution rates fall within average thresholds, its non-hyperthreaded core model provides predictable computational throughput. The instance is suited for multi-threaded compilation pipelines, parallel compute nodes, Redis instances, and batch processing workloads.
